card.name: Linking words in drug interaction statements
card.fires_on: Words that link a drug to its effect in drug interaction text, such as 'prolong' in QT prolongation, 'to' after 'shown', or 'a' before an enzyme substrate or inhibitor.

modes.label: Prolong before QT
modes.description: The verb prolong, or its first part, in phrases about drugs that lengthen the QT interval.
modes.example: are taking medications known to<< prolong>> the QTc interval. Permanently

modes.label: Linking words in interaction claims
modes.description: Small words like 'to', 'a', or 'of' that come right before the effect or role of an interacting drug.
modes.example: Fluvoxamine is<< a>> potent inhibitor of CYP1A2

card.plain: It fires on the small connecting words in drug interaction sentences, just before the effect or role of the drug is stated.
